description:
Technical Applications Products (TAP) has a requirement to purchase items for the Advanced Airborne Research Equipment
(AARE) suite, an airborne collection platform. These motors are used on the AARE suite in support of it's gas collection system.

This is a Brand Name solicitation. The specific brand and part numbers are below:
Item   Noun               Part Number     Qty
#1      Skurka Motor    K1009-100         5
